purpose: Test (not affirm) whether G10 2Y rate spreads align with FX spot moves; correlation only, not causation or tradable edge.

input.integrity_note: Pinned digest is sha256_json of parsed JSON excluding packet_sha256 (overnight packet convention). Raw file bytes sha256 differs because packet_sha256 is appended after content hash.

hypothesis.statement: Higher base-minus-quote 2Y spread (level or change) is associated with subsequent or contemporaneous appreciation of the BASE currency.
hypothesis.prior: Kevin: link is loose at best; financing spread does not establish spot direction.

yield_unit_note: 458 means 4.58 percent; spreads computed in bp as base_2Y minus quote_2Y.
proxy_note: 2Y yields are a policy-expectation PROXY, not forward carry and not the futures path.

excluded_coverage_only.nok_sek_gbp: No NOK, SEK, or GBP 2Y yield series in snapshot.
excluded_coverage_only.nz_pairs: NZ_2Y stored history too short; report NZ_2Y dates and length; no NZ pair correlations.

pooling: Do not pool the five pairs into one sample.

alignment.on: exact dates present in base yield, quote yield, and spot series
alignment.observation_step: One aligned row per shared date; calendar gap between consecutive aligned dates may exceed one day.

returns.k: h aligned observation steps, not calendar days

S1.label: LEVEL vs subsequent return
S1.y: spot log return from t to t+h

S2.label: CHANGE contemporaneous
S2.y: contemporaneous one-step spot log return (t-1 to t)

S3.label: CHANGE vs subsequent return
S3.y: spot log return from t to t+h

benchmark_B1.label: spot momentum
benchmark_B1.compare: R^2 vs spread specs; R^2 of no information is 0; do not claim tradable edge if differentials beat momentum in-sample only

statistics.t_stat: if printed label naive_independence; not evidence for overlapping returns
